# CardRoomPro / 雀阁 · 纸牌房

> CardRoomPro is a real-time web card-room platform for Doudizhu, Guandan, and four-player Mahjong, with AI seats, an advisor, spectators, replay history, leaderboards, and optional Discuz JWT SSO.

## Canonical links

- Live website: https://ddz.yutianfu.me/
- Source repository: https://github.com/TypeThe0ry/CardRoomPro
- English documentation: https://github.com/TypeThe0ry/CardRoomPro/blob/main/README.md
- Chinese documentation: https://github.com/TypeThe0ry/CardRoomPro/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md

## Product facts

- Doudizhu: 3 seats, bidding, landlord/farmer roles, bombs, spring multiplier, and AI opponents.
- Guandan: 4 seats, two decks, fixed partners, level progression, and team scoring.
- Mahjong: 4 seats, draw/discard, chi/peng/gang/hu, shanten analysis, effective tiles, and discard-risk advice.
- Authentication: optional Discuz-compatible JWT single sign-on; guest mode remains available.
- Data: public-room replays are viewable by everyone; private-room replays are restricted to participants.
- Stack: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Vue 2, and optional MySQL persistence.
